proposal.action_authorship: All plan action arguments supplied by plan author. Backend only schedules, validates and derives existing datums/proxies/revisions/native representations.

assumptions: The project is empty except for the floor, so all rover bodies and ShapeSpec parts must be created from scratch.
A tiny free root can be used as the required mobile root while the chassis carries the main vehicle mass.
Positive torque on both rear wheel hinges is chosen to produce forward motion along the chassis initial +X direction under the native frame conventions.
Small helper intermediaries with joint=null are valid fixed mounts when explicitly given nonzero mass and finite geometry.
assembly_plan.explanation: The rover uses a very small free root as the only mobile world root, a rectangular chassis fixed beneath it, fixed axle intermediaries registered to the chassis protected front_axle and rear_axle datums, axle parts anchored to those mount origins, four wheel hinge bodies registered at axle endpoints, four wheel parts attached to those hinges, and two rear fixed motor-mount intermediaries carrying motor_mount parts. Rear wheel hinges receive equal bounded positive torque for basic forward drive while front hinges remain passive.
assembly_plan.goal: Create a simple four-wheel toy rover with a rectangular chassis, front and rear axles, four wheels, two rear motor mounts, and basic powered forward motion from the rear wheels.
limitations: This plan is review-only and compilation-focused; it does not prove physical success, stability, traction, or collision-free motion.
Wheel rotation is limited to a single revolute range within +/-pi, so continuous multi-turn driving is unsupported.
There is no steering, suspension, differential, controller logic, wiring, or closed-loop speed regulation.
Motor mounts are structural parts only; they do not model real drivetrain coupling, bearings, or motor hardware.
Unsupported capabilities such as real-world safety guarantees, autonomy, or high-fidelity tire behavior are not claimed.

steps.purpose: Create the mobile root and the main chassis part.
Create fixed chassis axle intermediaries, axle parts, and register the chassis protected axle datums.
Create passive front wheel hinges at the front axle endpoints and attach the front wheels.
Create powered rear wheel hinges at the rear axle endpoints and attach the rear wheels.
Create fixed rear motor-mount intermediaries and attach the two motor-mount parts to the chassis rear protected mount datums.
